title: First Principles: What Is Money, Really?
summary: Before we touch a blockchain or a neural net, we need a shared definition of the thing they are all competing to redefine. A short history of money, the three functions, the modern banking stack, inflation as policy, and what 'hard' money means.
learningOutcomes: Tell the short history of money from shells to pixels and explain why each transition happened.
State the three functions of money and explain why they don't always live in the same object.
Describe the modern fiat-and-credit banking stack at a level that would survive a skeptical follow-up question.
Explain inflation as a policy choice rather than a natural phenomenon.
Define 'hard money' precisely and explain why anyone cares.
